module.title: non-ideal MHD terms, kinetic closures and the semi-implicit and part-implicit solvers (Hall, resistivity, viscosity, heat conduction, anisotropic pressure)
module.expensive_path: the gradient and current stencils (ModFaceGradient, ModCurrent) feeding the Hall and resistive fluxes, and the semi-implicit Krylov solve of ModSemiImplicit for field-aligned electron heat conduction: a preconditioned GMRES or BiCGSTAB over all blocks with a matrix-free Jacobian-vector product per iteration
module.rationale: the dissipative and closure physics beyond ideal MHD shares one numerical backbone, the implicit and semi-implicit machinery that removes its stiff time-step limit; the whistler-wave, viscous, conduction and anisotropic-pressure tests are the official coverage of that backbone
excluded: the hybrid (kinetic-ion) test test_hybrid: its user module ModUserHybrid lives in the access-restricted srcUserExtra repository and does not compile here
gray radiation diffusion and the HYPRE preconditioner (test_graydiffusion, test_laserpackage: srcUserExtra and CRASH)
the electron-pressure Awsom closures owned by the corona module
hazards: only four open official tests: this module is THIN and needs the human's explicit agreement
implicit Krylov solves converge to a tolerance, so pointwise agreement is bounded by the solver tolerance and iteration count, not by round-off
upstream compares the Hall test at 1e-5 relative, 2e-7 absolute and the conduction test at 1e-9 both ways

approval.human_ref: approve (2026-09-04, after the 8-module table and the interim measurements were shown in chat)
